source.title: MongoDB Chat Memory node doesn't set driverInfo, unlike the other MongoDB nodes

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
### Bug Description

The MongoDB Chat Memory node creates its `MongoClient` without `driverInfo`, so its connections don't identify themselves as n8n in the MongoDB connection handshake.

n8n's other MongoDB integrations already set this:

- The MongoDB node sets `driverInfo: { name: 'n8n_crud', version: <node version> }` in `packages/nodes-base/nodes/MongoDb/GenericFunctions.ts`.
- The MongoDB Atlas Vector Store node sets `driverInfo: { name: 'n8n_vector', version: <node version> }` in `packages/@n8n/nodes-langchain/nodes/vector_store/VectorStoreMongoDBAtlas/VectorStoreMongoDBAtlas.node.ts`.
- The MongoDB Chat Memory node, in `packages/@n8n/nodes-langchain/nodes/memory/MemoryMongoDbChat/MemoryMongoDbChat.node.ts`, only passes pool settings (`minPoolSize`, `maxPoolSize`, `maxIdleTimeMS`).

As a result, connections from the Chat Memory node can't be told apart from generic Node.js driver traffic in MongoDB Atlas, unlike connections from the other two nodes.

### To Reproduce

1. Create a workflow with a Chat Trigger connected to an AI Agent, then add a chat model and a MongoDB Chat Memory node using MongoDB credentials.
2. Send a chat message so the memory node opens a connection.
3. While the connection is open, run `db.currentOp(true)` in `mongosh` against the same deployment, and find the operation from n8n.
4. See that `clientMetadata.driver.name` is only `nodejs`, with no n8n entry.

### Expected behavior

As with the MongoDB and MongoDB Atlas Vector Store nodes, `clientMetadata.driver.name` should include an n8n entry for this node (for example `nodejs|n8n_memory`), and `clientMetadata.driver.version` should include the node version (for example `6.21.0|1.1`).

### Debug Info

Not available. This was found by reading the source on `master` (commit 4b5ea1de), and the same code ships in n8n@2.46.6. It applies regardless of environment.

### Operating System

macOS (Darwin 25.6.0); not environment-specific

### n8n Version

2.46.6

### Node.js Version

24.1.0

### Database

SQLite (default)

### Execution mode

main (default)

### Hosting

self hosted

comments.author: goutham-valugula
comments.text: The current source confirms the omission: `supplyData()` constructs `MongoClient` with only pool options. The Atlas vector-store node passes `driverInfo` in the same constructor, using its selected node version. The memory node can follow that pattern with a distinct name such as `n8n_memory` and `this.getNode().typeVersion.toString()`; its description already declares versions `[1, 1.1]`, so the reported version can track the actual node version.

comments.author: goutham-valugula
comments.text: One detail to account for in the fix: this node declares versions 1 and 1.1, so passing `this.getNode().typeVersion.toString()` to `driverInfo.version` will report the selected version. The Atlas vector-store helper already takes the runtime node version and passes it as a string; the memory node can use the same pattern with a distinct driver name such as `n8n_memory`.
